ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output text/plain fun esc(s) = (s default "") replace "&" with "&" replace "<" with "<" replace ">" with ">" replace "\"" with """ var page = readUrl("classpath://web/index.html", "text/plain") var c = vars.session.claims var who = if (c != null) "
✔ Signed in " ++ esc(c.name default c.preferred_username) ++ "" ++ " (" ++ esc(c.preferred_username) ++ " · " ++ esc(p('idp.detail')) ++ ")" ++ " Log out
" else "
Not signed in. Log in with " ++ esc(p('idp.label')) ++ "
" --- page replace "{{IDP}}" with esc(p('idp.label')) replace "{{WHO}}" with who replace "{{HIDDEN}}" with (if (c != null) "" else "hidden")

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import toBase64 from dw::core::Binaries import hashWith from dw::Crypto output application/java fun b64url(b) = toBase64(b) replace "+" with "-" replace "/" with "_" replace "=" with "" var verifier = (uuid() ++ uuid() ++ uuid()) replace "-" with "" --- { sid: (uuid() ++ uuid()) replace "-" with "", state: uuid(), verifier: verifier, challenge: b64url(hashWith(verifier as Binary {encoding: "UTF-8"}, "SHA-256")) }

%dw 2.0 import * from dw::core::URL output application/java var q = { client_id: p('idp.clientId'), response_type: "code", scope: p('idp.scope'), redirect_uri: vars.baseUrl ++ "/callback", state: vars.login.state, code_challenge: vars.login.challenge, code_challenge_method: "S256", prompt: "login" } --- { Location: p('idp.authorizeUrl') ++ "?" ++ ((q pluck ((v, k) -> encodeURIComponent(k as String) ++ "=" ++ encodeURIComponent(v))) joinBy "&"), "Set-Cookie": "sid=" ++ vars.login.sid ++ "; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/" ++ (if (vars.baseUrl startsWith "https") "; Secure" else "") }

when.expression: #[vars.session.state == null or vars.query.state != vars.session.state or vars.query.code == null]

set-payload.value: #['Login failed or expired: ' ++ (vars.query.error default 'state mismatch') ++ '. Start again']

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import * from dw::core::URL output application/java var q = {client_id: p('idp.clientId'), post_logout_redirect_uri: vars.baseUrl ++ p('idp.postLogoutPath')} ++ (if (vars.session.id_token != null) {id_token_hint: vars.session.id_token} else {}) --- { Location: p('idp.logoutUrl') ++ "?" ++ ((q pluck ((v, k) -> encodeURIComponent(k as String) ++ "=" ++ encodeURIComponent(v))) joinBy "&"), "Set-Cookie": "sid=; Max-Age=0; Path=/" }
